auth_methods.quote: The Zendesk API supports OAuth authorization flows.
auth_methods.note: OAuth access tokens (Bearer, global OAuth for multi-customer apps); API tokens (marked deprecated) are sent via Basic auth as email/token:api_token.

credential_access.quote: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
credential_access.note: Sponsored non-expiring dev account only for Marketplace partners; otherwise paid plan after trial.

production_gate.note: Two readings. (1) oauth_app_review: multi-customer apps must use a global OAuth client that Zendesk must approve ('If the request is approved, Zendesk converts your local OAuth client to a global OAuth client'). (2) partner_program: the request form only accepts d3v- sponsored accounts, which are reserved for Marketplace partners. Best guess: oauth_app_review.

api_type.note: REST /api/v2. A GraphQL page exists only under the Sell sales-crm search reference.

mcp_official.quote: Zendesk Bridge provides a way to establish governed connections between the Zendesk MCP Server or Zendesk AI agents and external AI agents
mcp_official.note: Vendor-run Zendesk MCP Server exists but is in early access program (EAP); counted as yes since it is vendor published per docs. No public GitHub MCP repo under github.com/zendesk.

main_blocker_type.quote: You must request a global OAuth client from Zendesk to create global OAuth tokens.
main_blocker_type.note: Multi-tenant OAuth requires Zendesk-approved global client; sponsored accounts partner-only.
